notes_for_editor: No primary sources found (Marine annual reports and corpus have no Cape Bonavista text; Newfoundland House of Assembly journals not online to us). Most detail rests on LighthouseFriends, which cites Journal of the House of Assembly and Molloy 1994; its 1842 opening conflicts with 1843 elsewhere. The CSCE plaque wording page has a typo (decommissioned 1862) vs 1962. The record's 1966 first_lit/deactivated events and 'tower 1843 12.7 m' not checked. Kure encyclopedia (AI-generated) claims White died 1876: not used. Quotes from LF rely on cached text with replacement characters, so quotes avoid those. Staffed status in record refers to museum staff; light itself automated on skeletal tower. Pounds sign (cache shows replacement character) written as pound in story. Tourism listing season dates have no stated year. Fact-check: LighthouseFriends' building narrative is internally inconsistent (Kough's 1 November voyage, then 'May of 1842'); story now says so. Bell Rock date 1811 (CSCE) vs 1810 (Nevill) stated. CSCE plaque wording misprints 1862.
